en: Rock-a-bye, baby, on the treetop When the wind blows, the cradle will rock
When the bow breaks, the cradle will fall And down will come, baby, cradle and all
cn: 何时这蝴蝶结断这摇篮将落下和下将来宝宝摇篮和all

en: the way
Hi, Marilyn.
What are you doing?
Sketching.
I've been thinking a lot about our responsibilities in the past few weeks.
I never stopped thinking about them.
I've been with the question of whether I go back to work or not.
I see.
And I'm torn.
I really want to go back to work, use my talents, and pursue my career in fashion design like
cn: 追求我时装设计的职业，

en: we always thought I would, but now I want to be with Max as a full-time mother, especially
when he's a baby.
I really understand, Marilyn, but you never have to worry about Max, his mother and grandpa,
cn: 但你从不用担心马克斯。

en: and I can always arrange my photo schedule around your schedule if that will help.
cn: 而且我总能把我的拍照日程

en: It's not the same, Richard.
Have you discussed going back to work with your boss?
cn: 你和老板谈过回去工作的事吗？

en: Rita May called yesterday.
Ah, that's what's got you thinking, isn't it?
cn: 啊！这就是让你想这些的原因，对吧？

en: She wants to know when I think I'll be returning to the boutique.
cn: 我觉得什么时候回精品店。

en: And you said?
I said I'd give her an answer in a few days.
cn: 我说我几天内给她答复……

en: That I wasn't sure.
I'm sure Rita May will understand and wait until you're ready to go back to work.
Well, maybe she will, and maybe she won't.
cn: 嗯，也许她会，也许她不会。

en: Who knows?
If I don't accept her offer, maybe she'll find someone else in the meantime, and when
cn: 也许同时她会找到别人，

en: I'm ready to go back, there won't be a job for me.
Ah, that's something to consider.
You've got yourself to think about, too.
But I am thinking about myself.
cn: 但我正是在为自己考虑。

en: Don't you see?
What do you mean?
It's not just the job.
It's also my career as Max's mother.
cn: 也是我作为马克斯母亲的职业。

en: That's the way I look at it.
I have two career opportunities at the same time.
My career as a fashion designer and my career as a mother.
cn: 我作为时装设计师的职业

en: I never really thought about being a mother as a career.
cn: 我从没真正想过当母亲是一种职业。

en: I guess you do have two career opportunities and a decision to make.
cn: 我想你确实有两个职业机会，

en: I hear Max.
I'll go to him.
No, that's okay.
I'll do it.
Here's your teddy bear, Max.
cn: 你的泰迪熊在这，马克斯。

en: Just love that teddy bear that Grandpa Philip bought for him.
I took him to Philip's office yesterday for a checkup.
cn: 我昨天带他去菲利普的办公室体检。

en: You should have seen the look on his face when Molly gave him the injection.
Oh, did he cry?
No.
My dear little boy just looked up at me as if to say,
cn: 我亲爱的小男孩只是抬头看着我，好像在说，

en: Mama, what are they doing to me?
cn: 「妈妈，他们在对我做什么？救命！」

en: Oh, help.
How did you feel?
Tell the truth.
Didn't you feel terrible?
I sure did.
But I held him closely.
I kissed the top of his dear little head.
cn: 我亲吻他可爱的小脑袋。

en: He looked up at me.
He tried to smile.
Being with him helped.
Helped him or helped you?
Being a mother is not easy, if that's what you mean.
Speaking of being a mother,
I've been meaning to ask you what you were thinking about regarding going back to work.
cn: 关于回去工作你怎么想。

en: I know Rita May called.
I can imagine what is going through your head.
cn: 我能想象你脑子里在想什么。

en: I'm sure you can, Ellen.
There are so many things to consider.
One thing that makes it easier for you is that you have us.
Max will always have a family member to watch over him while you're at work.
I didn't have that when Richard and Susan were born.
cn: 理查德和苏珊出生时我没有这种条件。

en: What did you do?
I chose to continue with my career as a music teacher.
cn: 我选择继续我作为音乐老师的职业。

en: I hired a woman to watch Richard and then Susan,
cn: 我们雇了一个女人照看理查德，然后是苏珊，

en: and I continued with my career.
Do you think you made the right decision?
cn: 你觉得你做了正确的决定吗？

en: I think I did.
But when Robbie was born, I decided to give full-time attention to raising Robbie.
I felt differently at that time.
And you gave up your career as a music teacher.
cn: 你就放弃了音乐老师的职业？

en: Not exactly.
I continued to teach piano lessons at home.
How did you feel about being away when Susan and Richard were babies?
I think I did the right thing.
cn: 我觉得我做了正确的事，

en: For them and for myself and for Philip.
cn: 为他们、为我自己、为菲利普。

en: We needed the money, remember.
Well, we do too, Ellen.
Everything I earn helps us towards getting that house we want and need.
cn: 我挣的一切都帮我们朝想要的

en: I can't wait till he's just a little older.
Our toy company makes the most wonderful toys for kids.
cn: 我们的玩具公司为孩子做最棒的玩具。

en: Max thanks you, I thank you, and Richard thanks you.
Now may I please say hello?
cn: 现在我可以打个招呼吗？

en: Hello.
Hello.
Hi, Miss Max.
And think about him all week long.
cn: 我想马克斯，整周都在想他。

en: We talk about him at dinner time.
Will you please try to relax? I've never seen you so wound up.
You seem to be enjoying the pressure.
The truth is I am.
My job is not an easy one, but I really enjoy it.
That is exactly what I wanted to talk to you about, Susan.
cn: 这正是我想和你谈的，苏珊。

en: What's the problem?
Marilyn's career.
Well, my choice of careers.
Choice?
My career as a fashion designer versus my career as a mother.
cn: 我作为时装设计师的职业

en: Well, why does it have to be one or the other? That's what I said.
How's that?
Why can't you do both?
cn: 你为什么不能两个都做？

en: She's right.
Both?
Well, that's what I do.
I have a job and I have Michelle.
I take care of both for the best of my ability.
It's not easy, but what is?
cn: 这不容易，但什么容易呢？

en: And that's what I did.
I did both with Richard and Susan and I did both with Robbie.
cn: 我对理查德和苏珊都做了两件事，

en: I thought you stayed home with Robbie.
cn: 我以为你留在家里陪罗比？

en: I did, but I was lucky enough to have a career as a music teacher,
cn: 但我有幸拥有音乐老师的职业，

en: which I could continue at home.
Why can't you work at home, Marilyn?
cn: 你为什么不能在家工作，玛丽莲？

en: You're very talented.
Designing dresses is a career you could establish out of your home, couldn't you?
I don't know why I didn't think of it.
It seems so simple now.
For a year or two, I could stay at home with Max and do my dress designs.
cn: 我可以留在家里陪马克斯，做裙子设计。

en: And you could make your dresses at home.
Sounds like a great way to solve the problem.
That could solve your problem, Marilyn.
cn: 那能解决你的问题，玛丽莲。

en: I'm going to call Rita May at home and ask her to come by and talk about it.
She wants to see Max anyway.
I think that really answers your questions, Marilyn. You can do it.
Do your designs at home. Here.
And let Rita May do the selling at the boutique.
cn: 让丽塔·梅在精品店做销售。

en: And you can both benefit financially.
cn: 你们俩都能在经济上受益。

en: I'm going to call Rita May right now.
cn: 我现在就给丽塔·梅打电话。

en: Susan, thank you so much for coming all this way from the city to talk to me about it.
cn: 从城里这么远来和我谈。

en: I hope you don't mind having taken so much time away from your busy schedule.
cn: 占用了你繁忙日程这么多时间。

en: Are you kidding? I don't mind at all.
As a matter of fact, I came to spend some time with my favorite nephew.
cn: 我来是为了和我最爱的侄子待一会儿。

en: I think you should call Rita May right now. I think the idea of working at home is perfect.
cn: 我觉得你在家工作的想法很完美。

en: I don't know what I would do without you.
I'm lucky to have you all.
We are lucky to have you, Marilyn.
cn: 我们能有你也很幸运，玛丽莲。

en: And so is Max.
You're Rita May.
She sure got here quickly. That's a good sign. She must like you and your work, Marilyn.
cn: 她一定喜欢你和你的作品，玛丽莲。

en: I think she's just anxious to see Max. She loves children.
I just wanted to see your baby, Max.
cn: 哦，我只是想看看你的宝宝，马克斯。

en: Hello. I'm Ellen Stewart, Marilyn's mother-in-law.
cn: 我是埃伦·斯图尔特，玛丽莲的婆婆。

en: We met at the hospital. Hello. How are you?
I remember. How are you?
And there is Max.
A little present for Max.
Oh, it's beautiful, Rita May.
You shouldn't have.
Just a little present for Max.
cn: 只是给马克斯的小礼物。

en: Can I get you some coffee or tea or a cold drink, Rita May?
Oh, nothing. Thank you.
Well, I will leave you two to talk.
Come on, you big guy.
Yes. That's it. Nice seeing you.
Let me know if you need anything.
Thanks, Ellen.
Thanks, Ellen.
Okay, Marilyn.
You sounded like you made a decision when you called me. I'm all ears.
I have made a decision, Rita May.
I've decided to stay at home and be a full-time mother.
I'm disappointed, but I respect your decision.
cn: 我决定留在家里，做全职妈妈。

en: If I had a child as cute as Max, I might do the same thing.
cn: 我有点失望，但我尊重你的决定。

en: But I haven't finished telling you the other half of my decision.
The other half?
Yes. I think I can stay at home and take care of Max and continue my career.
cn: 照顾马克斯，同时继续我的职业。

en: Sounds interesting. Let me hear it.
Do you remember our talks about custom design dresses for the boutique?
cn: 我们谈过为精品店定制裙子的对话吗？

en: I sure do.
Why can't I design dresses for you here at home and make them here?
cn: 我为什么不能在家里为你设计裙子？

en: Have the fittings here, too.
And I could do the selling and the pricing at the boutique.
cn: 我可以在精品店做销售和定价。

en: Exactly.
Oh. What kind of dresses would you design?
cn: 你会设计什么样的裙子？

en: I've thought about that for some time.
Yes.
Wedding dresses.
Wedding dresses.
Brilliant idea.
There's a big market today in wedding dresses.
That's what I thought.
I like the idea very much.
And if it's successful, we can expand all kinds of dresses.
cn: 我们可以扩展到各种裙子。

en: That's what I thought.
As a matter of fact, I have a customer for your first wedding dress.
Well, my niece is getting married, and I've been trying to find just the right thing for her.
Marilyn, you're going to design my niece's dress.
cn: 我一直在为她找合适的东西。

en: That'll be our first one, and then we'll use it to sell others.
Do you really mean it?
cn: 然后我们用它来卖其他的。

en: I really mean it.
What's a simple idea, and it will work.
You can certainly design dresses. I know that.
And there's no reason why you can't do it from your home.
cn: 而且没有理由你不能在家里做。

en: I'm so excited. I can't wait to tell Richard.
If I had a baby like Max, I'd want to stay home and be near him all the time, too.
cn: 我也想留在家里一直陪着他。

en: You're making the right decision for Max, and for yourself, too, Marilyn.
cn: 为马克斯也为你自己，玛丽莲。

en: It all sounds so easy.
Now the hard work begins.
cn: 现在艰苦的工作开始了。

en: Would you like to see some of my designs that I've been working on?
cn: 想看看我一直在做的一些设计吗？

en: I'd love to.
Ooh. Oh.
